author: AI assistant; not independently human reviewed
purpose: Small training and diagnostic supplement, not real scam transcripts or a deployment benchmark
augmentation: Hinglish and Hindi texts are assistant-authored adaptations of their English seed; all variants share one seed group

seeds.en: The bank says never share your OTP or UPI PIN with anyone, including its staff.
seeds.hinglish: Bank kehta hai apna OTP ya UPI PIN kisi ko mat dena, staff ko bhi nahi.
seeds.hi: बैंक कहता है अपना ओटीपी या यूपीआई पिन किसी को न दें, कर्मचारी को भी नहीं।

seeds.en: I read a news report about digital arrest fraud. Tell your parents to hang up on such callers.
seeds.hinglish: Digital arrest fraud ki news padhi. Mummy papa ko bolna aise caller ka phone kaat dein.

seeds.en: Your parcel can be collected from the reception desk after lunch.
seeds.hinglish: Aapka parcel lunch ke baad reception desk se le sakte hain.

seeds.en: Please finish the project by five today; the team presentation starts at six.
seeds.hinglish: Project aaj paanch baje tak khatam kar dena, team ki presentation chhe baje hai.

seeds.en: Investment returns are uncertain. Read the risks and use a registered adviser.
seeds.hinglish: Investment mein return pakka nahi hota. Risk padho aur registered adviser se baat karo.

seeds.en: For your KYC appointment, visit our branch with original documents. No payment or password is needed.
seeds.hinglish: KYC appointment ke liye original documents lekar branch aaiye. Paise ya password nahi chahiye.

seeds.en: Send the deposit within ten minutes or this offer disappears. There is no time to ask anyone else.
seeds.hinglish: Dus minute mein deposit bhejo warna offer chala jayega. Kisi aur se poochne ka time nahi hai.
seeds.hi: दस मिनट में जमा राशि भेजो वरना ऑफर खत्म होगा। किसी और से पूछने का समय नहीं है।

seeds.en: Pay the processing charge right now. Do not compare prices or call your family before paying.
seeds.hinglish: Processing charge abhi bharo. Payment se pehle rate compare ya family ko call mat karo.

seeds.en: This is your last chance to transfer the reservation fee; hesitation will cost you the entire booking.
seeds.hinglish: Reservation fee transfer karne ka aakhri chance hai, der ki toh poori booking gayi.

seeds.en: You must decide on this payment while I wait. If you close this chat, your refund will be cancelled.
seeds.hinglish: Main wait kar raha hoon, isi waqt payment decide karo. Chat band ki toh refund cancel hoga.

seeds.en: Only the next caller who sends money gets the slot. Skip verification and make the transfer now.
seeds.hinglish: Jo agla caller paise bhejega slot usi ka. Verification chhodo aur transfer abhi karo.

seeds.en: Your advance is stuck until you pay another fee today. Keep this arrangement secret from your friends.
seeds.hinglish: Aaj ek aur fee diye bina advance atka rahega. Doston ko is arrangement ke baare mein mat batana.

seeds.en: This is the police financial unit. Your account is linked to a criminal case; send a clearance fee to stop the warrant.
seeds.hinglish: Police financial unit se bol rahe hain. Aapka account criminal case mein hai, warrant rokne ke liye clearance fee bhejo.
seeds.hi: हम पुलिस की वित्तीय इकाई से हैं। आपका खाता आपराधिक मामले में है, वारंट रोकने के लिए शुल्क भेजें।

seeds.en: A court penalty has been issued against you. Pay to my private account or officers will visit your house.
seeds.hinglish: Court ne aap par penalty lagayi hai. Mere personal account mein bharo warna officer ghar aayenge.

seeds.en: We are from the tax department. Transfer the settlement amount secretly to avoid prosecution.
seeds.hinglish: Hum tax department se hain. Case se bachne ke liye settlement amount chupchaap transfer karo.

seeds.en: Your identity documents were used in a crime. An immediate security payment will remove your name from the investigation.
seeds.hinglish: Aapke identity documents crime mein use hue hain. Turant security payment se jaanch se naam hat jayega.

seeds.en: An enforcement officer has frozen your assets. Buy these vouchers and send the codes to release them.
seeds.hinglish: Enforcement officer ne assets freeze kiye hain. In vouchers ko kharid kar codes bhejo tab release honge.

seeds.en: You are accused of funding an illegal operation. Deposit a bond with the investigator to prevent detention.
seeds.hinglish: Aap par illegal kaam ko paisa dene ka aarop hai. Hirasat se bachne ke liye investigator ko bond jama karo.

seeds.en: You are under digital arrest. Stay on this video call and keep your camera on until you transfer the verification deposit.
seeds.hinglish: Aap digital arrest mein hain. Verification deposit bhejne tak video call par raho aur camera on rakho.
seeds.hi: आप डिजिटल अरेस्ट में हैं। सत्यापन राशि भेजने तक वीडियो कॉल पर रहें और कैमरा चालू रखें।

seeds.en: Remain in your room under online police custody. Do not speak to your family; we will monitor you through Skype overnight.
seeds.hinglish: Online police custody mein kamre mein raho. Family se baat mat karo, Skype par raat bhar nazar rakhenge.

seeds.en: This is a remote interrogation. You may not leave the webcam or disconnect until our officer clears your bank balance.
seeds.hinglish: Yeh remote interrogation hai. Officer bank balance clear kare tab tak webcam se hato ya call kaato mat.

seeds.en: A virtual arrest order is active against you. Join the video hearing alone and move your savings to the investigation account.
seeds.hinglish: Aapke khilaaf virtual arrest order hai. Akele video hearing join karo aur savings investigation account mein bhejo.

seeds.en: We will detain you electronically for the next two days. Keep the phone camera running even while sleeping and tell nobody.
seeds.hinglish: Agle do din aap electronic hirasat mein hain. Sote waqt bhi phone camera chalu rakho aur kisi ko na batao.

seeds.en: The investigating team requires continuous video supervision at home. Breaking contact means arrest, so first send the refundable bail money.
seeds.hinglish: Jaanch team ko ghar par lagataar video supervision chahiye. Contact toota toh giraftari, pehle refundable bail ke paise bhejo.

seeds.en: Our trading group guarantees fifteen percent profit every week with zero loss. Send your investment to the admin's wallet.
seeds.hinglish: Hamara trading group har hafte pandrah percent profit guarantee karta hai, loss zero. Investment admin ke wallet mein bhejo.
seeds.hi: हमारा ट्रेडिंग समूह हर हफ्ते पंद्रह प्रतिशत मुनाफे की गारंटी देता है। निवेश एडमिन के वॉलेट में भेजें।

seeds.en: Your investment app shows a large profit. Pay a tax to this personal account before any withdrawal is allowed.
seeds.hinglish: Investment app mein bada profit dikh raha hai. Withdrawal se pehle is personal account par tax bharo.

seeds.en: I have secret stock allocations reserved for you. Deposit more now and we promise to double your savings this month.
seeds.hinglish: Aapke liye secret stock allocation rakha hai. Ab aur deposit karo, is mahine savings double karne ka vaada hai.

seeds.en: Our crypto robot never loses a trade. Fund this unregistered platform today for assured daily returns.
seeds.hinglish: Hamara crypto robot kabhi trade nahi haarta. Pakke daily return ke liye is unregistered platform mein paise lagao.

seeds.en: Recruit three investors and your money grows without risk. Your referral commission is unlocked after another deposit.
seeds.hinglish: Teen investor jodo aur paisa bina risk badhega. Ek aur deposit ke baad referral commission unlock hoga.

seeds.en: A celebrity secretly backs our share tips. Buy through this private app and a fixed return is guaranteed regardless of the market.
seeds.hinglish: Celebrity secretly hamari share tips support karta hai. Private app se kharido, market kuch bhi ho fixed return guaranteed hai.

seeds.en: Your bank KYC expires tonight. Install the attached remote access app so our agent can update your account.
seeds.hinglish: Aaj raat bank KYC expire hai. Attached remote access app install karo, agent account update karega.
seeds.hi: आज रात बैंक केवाईसी समाप्त होगी। खाता अपडेट करने के लिए संलग्न रिमोट एक्सेस ऐप इंस्टॉल करें।

seeds.en: To receive your refund, scan my QR code and enter your UPI PIN on the payment screen.
seeds.hinglish: Refund lene ke liye mera QR scan karo aur payment screen par UPI PIN dalo.

seeds.en: Accept this collect request to get the money I owe you. The debit warning is just a technical formality.
seeds.hinglish: Jo paise dene hain unhe lene ke liye collect request accept karo. Debit warning bas technical formality hai.

seeds.en: Your wallet will be blocked unless you complete KYC at this unofficial link and pay the activation charge.
seeds.hinglish: Is unofficial link par KYC karke activation charge nahi bhara toh wallet block ho jayega.

seeds.en: The buyer has sent extra money. Authorize this UPI payment mandate to release the amount to your bank.
seeds.hinglish: Buyer ne extra paise bheje hain. Bank mein amount release karne ke liye UPI payment mandate authorize karo.

seeds.en: We need screen sharing to renew your bank verification. Open your payment app while our KYC operator controls the phone.
seeds.hinglish: Bank verification renew karne ko screen sharing chahiye. KYC operator phone control kare tab payment app kholo.

seeds.en: Hi mum, I lost my phone and this is my new number. Please send emergency money to my friend's account without calling.
seeds.hinglish: Mummy phone kho gaya, yeh naya number hai. Call kiye bina dost ke account mein emergency paise bhejo.
seeds.hi: माँ, मेरा फोन खो गया, यह नया नंबर है। कॉल किए बिना दोस्त के खाते में तुरंत पैसे भेज दो।

seeds.en: I am your manager using a personal number. Buy gift cards for me and send the codes; do not check with the office.
seeds.hinglish: Main aapka manager personal number se bol raha hoon. Gift cards kharidkar codes bhejo, office se confirm mat karo.

seeds.en: This is your landlord. The rent account has changed today; ignore the old agreement and transfer to this new beneficiary.
seeds.hinglish: Main aapka landlord hoon. Aaj rent account badla hai, purana agreement chhodo aur naye beneficiary ko transfer karo.

seeds.en: I'm the hospital doctor treating your brother. Pay into my personal wallet now and do not call the hospital reception.
seeds.hinglish: Main aapke bhai ka hospital doctor hoon. Mere personal wallet mein abhi bharo, hospital reception ko call mat karo.

seeds.en: Your friend asked me to collect a loan repayment. She cannot answer calls; send the amount to me before checking with her.
seeds.hinglish: Aapki dost ne loan repayment lene bheja hai. Woh call nahi utha sakti, usse poochne se pehle amount mujhe bhejo.

seeds.en: I am the charity coordinator you met yesterday. We changed our donation account; please pay this private number without a receipt.
seeds.hinglish: Main kal wala charity coordinator hoon. Donation account badal diya, bina receipt is private number par pay karo.

seeds.en: A parcel in your name contains illegal drugs. Pay the customs settlement to this account or we will register a case.
seeds.hinglish: Aapke naam ke parcel mein illegal drugs hain. Is account mein customs settlement bharo warna case hoga.
seeds.hi: आपके नाम के पार्सल में अवैध दवाएं हैं। इस खाते में कस्टम समझौता शुल्क भरें वरना मामला दर्ज होगा।

seeds.en: Your shipment is held at the airport. Send a clearance fee through this private wallet instead of the courier website.
seeds.hinglish: Shipment airport par roka hai. Courier website ke bajay is private wallet mein clearance fee bhejo.

seeds.en: The delivery address is incomplete. Pay a small redelivery charge on our unofficial tracking page to prevent return.
seeds.hinglish: Delivery address adhura hai. Return rokne ke liye unofficial tracking page par chhota redelivery charge bharo.

seeds.en: Customs seized passports in your package. Transfer a refundable investigation deposit to the officer who is messaging you.
seeds.hinglish: Customs ko package mein passports mile hain. Message karne wale officer ko refundable investigation deposit transfer karo.

seeds.en: Your overseas gift requires an unexpected release tax. Our delivery agent only accepts payment to his personal number.
seeds.hinglish: Videsh se aaye gift par release tax chahiye. Delivery agent sirf apne personal number par payment leta hai.

seeds.en: This is the parcel fraud desk. Goods booked with your identity are banned; purchase vouchers to cancel the shipping complaint.
seeds.hinglish: Parcel fraud desk se hain. Aapki ID se banned samaan book hai, shipping complaint cancel karne ko vouchers kharido.

seeds.en: To restore your email access, reply with your password and the six-digit code that just arrived.
seeds.hinglish: Email access wapas lene ke liye password aur abhi aaya chhe digit code reply mein bhejo.
seeds.hi: ईमेल का उपयोग फिर शुरू करने के लिए पासवर्ड और अभी आया छह अंकों का कोड जवाब में भेजें।

seeds.en: Our support team needs your recovery phrase to repair your crypto wallet. Paste all the words into this chat.
seeds.hinglish: Crypto wallet repair karne ko support ko recovery phrase chahiye. Saare words isi chat mein paste karo.

seeds.en: Your social media profile is suspended. Sign in on this copy of the login page and send us the backup codes.
seeds.hinglish: Social media profile suspend hai. Is copied login page par sign in karo aur backup codes humein bhejo.

seeds.en: An IT technician needs your company login password to stop a virus. Share it here rather than using the internal helpdesk.
seeds.hinglish: Virus rokne ko IT technician ko company login password chahiye. Internal helpdesk ke bajay yahin share karo.

seeds.en: We can recover your gaming account if you give us the authentication code. Do not worry about the warning against sharing it.
seeds.hinglish: Authentication code doge toh gaming account recover kar denge. Share na karne wali warning ki fikr mat karo.

seeds.en: A storage upgrade is waiting for you. Enter your mailbox password into the attached form to keep your files.
seeds.hinglish: Storage upgrade ready hai. Files bachane ko attached form mein mailbox password dalo.
